enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Stretch legs. Turn to right side. Move arm. Sigh. Turn to back. Adjust blanket. Scratch nose. Turn to left side. Bend arm. Rest head on pillow. Breathe deeply.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Place bread on plate. Open microwave. Put plate in microwave. Close microwave. Press start button. Wait. Microwave beeps. Open microwave. Take out plate. Place on table. Sit on chair. Eat bread. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Lay clothes on bed. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out belt. Put on belt. Pick up bag. Put wallet in bag. Put phone in bag. Check mirror. Walk out.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Get on bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

Arrive at facility. Clock in. Put on ID badge. Wash hands. Review patient files. Visit patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Take notes. Administer medication. Update charts. Consult with doctor. Attend briefing. Take lunch break. Return to work. Assist colleague. Clock out.

Walk out of workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Get on bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Adjust volume. Lean back. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up.
Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Sit on bed. Read. Turn page. Read. Adjust pillow. Continue reading. Turn page. Read. Close book. Turn off lamp. Lie down.

Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Type password. Open browser. Check emails. Browse websites. Type on keyboard. Move mouse. Click. Open document. Type text. Save file. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait for hot water. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse. Apply shampoo. Rub scalp. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth.
Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Bend knees. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Breathe slowly.
